Resource Corner Pty Ltd has been built on the principles of integrity, partnership and innovation, traits that have allowed Resource Corner to establish itself as leader in its field since 2006. Resource Corner is global technology enterprise, focused on delivering excellence in complex digital environment, with relentless dedication in IT consulting and services. Resource Corner IT has been working with Banking and Telecom and Federal Department to help them achieve business agility, competitive edge, and growth.

Position Summary:
We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Software Tester to join our team in Australia.
Job location:
Head Office is in Norwest Business Park, Norwest NSW 2153, you will be required to work on clients' office (on multiple locations possible), depending on the engagement, whilst remaining a direct employee of Resource Corner

Type of position:
Permanent Ongoing

Minimum Qualification:
Any bachelor’s degree in major computing or equivalent

Experience Range: 5 to 15 years.

Job Description – Software Tester

Responsibilities:

• Researching, consulting, analyzing and evaluating system program needs.
• Identifying technology limitations and deficiencies in existing systems and associated processes, procedures and methods.
• Testing, debugging, diagnosing and correcting errors and faults in an applications programming language within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure programs and applications perform to specification.
• Writing and maintaining program code to meet system requirements, system designs and technical specifications in accordance with quality accredited standards.
• Writing, updating and maintaining technical program, end user documentation and operational procedures.
• Providing advice, guidance and expertise in developing proposals and strategies for software design activities such as financial evaluation and costing for recommending software purchases and upgrades.

Skills Required:

• Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent experience in IT highly regarded.
• Business orientation with strong IT background.
• 5+ years’ experience in software testing in banking, cards, payments, insurance or financial services environment is desirable.
• Experience in automation testing using selenium, java, tosca, cucumber, cypress or any other automation tool.
• Experience on manual, functional and regression testing is good to have.
• Payments experience with testing on cards, POS & terminal testing is a plus.
• Testing APIs using REST, SOAP UI, Postman etc.
• Experience on ETL, Data warehouse, Big Data testing is advantageous.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills at all levels.


Salary Range: $100k to $150k plus super

Next steps
If you feel this opportunity suits you, or RESOURCE CORNER IT is the type of organization you would like to join, we want to have a conversation with you! Please apply directly with us.

If you have a passion for leveraging the best from cutting-edge technologies; have an eye for elegance, flexibility and efficiency in design; and are passionate about technology we want to hear from you.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytically minded Data Analyst to join our team and play a key role in transforming raw data into meaningful business insights. In this position, you will gather, process, and interpret data to support strategic decision-making across the organisation. The ideal candidate is highly proficient with data tools and visualisation techniques, communicates findings clearly, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
Establish and maintain secure processes for collecting, storing, processing, and validating data to ensure integrity across all stages of the data lifecycle
Evaluate the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data from multiple sources, identifying and resolving discrepancies as required
Analyse and interpret complex datasets to produce relevant statistics, identify trends and patterns, and provide data-driven answers to business queries
Apply data analytics and visualisation techniques to uncover actionable insights that support operational and strategic goals
Develop clear, compelling reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions
Write custom scripts and code in languages such as Python, R, or SQL to automate analytical tasks and streamline data workflows
Implement and adhere to data governance frameworks, ensuring all data usage is ethical, compliant, and aligned with organisational policies
Monitor data pipelines and reporting systems, proactively identifying and resolving issues that may affect data quality or availability
Support the continuous improvement of data collection methodologies, reporting tools, and analytical processes across the business
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
Demonstrated experience in a data analyst or similar role, with a strong portfolio of analytical work
Proficiency in data analysis and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker
Strong working knowledge of SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets
Experience with programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and automation
Solid understanding of statistical methods, data modelling, and analytical best practices
Ability to interpret and communicate complex data findings clearly to diverse audiences
Familiarity with data governance principles, data quality standards, and privacy legislation including the Australian Privacy Act
Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative approach to working across teams
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification or certifications in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related discipline (e.g. Google Data Analytics Certificate, Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate)
Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
Exposure to machine learning concepts or predictive modelling techniques
Experience in an Agile or cross-functional project environment
Industry experience in sectors such as finance, healthcare, retail, or government
Why Join Us?
Be part of a collaborative, inclusive team culture that values curiosity, innovation, and continuous learning
Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options to support work-life balance
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including training, certifications, and conference attendance
Contribute to meaningful, high-impact projects that drive real business outcomes across the organisation
Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits including superannuation, wellness initiatives, and career progression pathways
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Job Summary
Ausgreen Solar Solutions is a renewable energy solutions provider operating across New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory, specialising in the supply of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and energy efficiency products for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The business provides tailored renewable energy solutions, technical product advice, and professional support to assist customers in adopting sustainable energy systems.
We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced Marketing Specialist to join our team on a full-time basis. This role is ideal for a creative and analytical marketing professional who enjoys developing marketing strategies, conducting market research, managing promotional activities, and supporting business growth within a growing renewable energy industry.

Why You'll Love This Role
• Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
• Location: NSW 2200 & ACT 2601
• Full-time, ongoing position
• Work within a growing renewable energy business
• Opportunity to develop marketing strategies within the clean energy sector
• Career development opportunities in a growing industry

• Develop and implement marketing strategies to promote the company’s renewable energy products and services across residential, commercial, and industrial markets.
• Conduct market research to identify customer trends, market opportunities, competitor activities, and changes in consumer demand.

• Develop and maintain the company’s brand positioning and ensure consistent communication across marketing channels.
• Identify target customer segments and develop strategies to improve customer engagement and market reach.
• Coordinate with sales and technical teams to ensure marketing activities effectively support business objectives.
• Monitor competitor marketing activities and provide insights to management regarding market positioning and opportunities.
• Maintain records of marketing activities, budgets, campaign performance, and outcomes.

What We're Looking For

• Relevant qualification in marketing, business, communications, or a related field.
• Minimum one year of relevant experience in marketing, digital marketing, or a similar role.
• Experience developing and implementing marketing strategies and promotional campaigns.
• Strong understanding of market research, customer analysis, and marketing principles.
• Experience managing digital marketing channels, social media platforms, and online campaigns.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to analyse market data and prepare reports to support business decisions.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple marketing activities.
• Creative, proactive, and results-oriented approach.
• Willingness to develop industry knowledge in renewable energy and sustainability solutions.

Full-time Carpenter / Cabinet Maker position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Hillsdale, NSW 2036. Apply today through 11 Recruitment!

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Carpenter / Cabinet Maker
•	$75,000 – $90,000 p.a. plus superannuation
•	Work across high-quality residential and commercial joinery and carpentry projects.

Position Overview:
Best2Joinery Carpentry & Projects is a growing Australian construction business specialising in carpentry, joinery, cabinet making, labour hire and residential and commercial projects across Sydney and Melbourne. The company is committed to delivering quality workmanship, reliable service and tailored building solutions. This role requires a skilled tradesperson with strong craftsmanship, attention to detail and the ability to work independently and within a team.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Interpret architectural drawings, joinery details, specifications and project documentation to manufacture and install custom timber and cabinetry solutions for residential and commercial projects.
•	Measure, mark, cut, machine and assemble timber, laminates, MDF, plywood and other materials to construct high-quality cabinetry, joinery and carpentry components.
•	Manufacture and install custom kitchens, wardrobes, vanities, entertainment units, office fit outs and bespoke joinery to client and project specifications.
•	Construct, install and finish doors, frames, skirting boards, architraves, stair components, wall linings, flooring and other structural and decorative carpentry elements.
•	Install and adjust cabinetry, benchtops, hardware, hinges, drawer systems and other fittings to achieve precise alignment, functionality and premium finishes.
•	Carry out on-site fit-outs, alterations and refurbishment works while ensuring minimal disruption to clients and other trades working on residential and commercial projects.
•	Select appropriate materials, hardware and construction methods to ensure durability, functionality, aesthetic quality and compliance with Australian Standards and building regulations.
•	Operate, maintain and safely use a wide range of woodworking machinery, hand tools and power tools while following workplace health and safety procedures.
•	Inspect completed carpentry and joinery work, identify defects or variations, perform adjustments where required and ensure all work meets company quality standards before handover.
•	Collaborate with project managers, supervisors, cabinet makers, carpenters and other construction trades to coordinate installation schedules and achieve project deadlines.
•	Estimate material requirements, minimize waste, maintain accurate records of materials used and assist in maintaining efficient workshop and site operations.
•	Maintain a clean, organized and safe workshop and worksite while delivering exceptional workmanship and professional customer service that reflects Best2Joinery Carpentry & Projects' commitment to quality and reliability. 

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification.
•	Minimum 1 year experience as a Carpenter / Cabinet Maker.
•	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.
•	High level of workmanship and attention to detail.
•	Strong knowledge of construction materials, joinery techniques and WHS requirements.
•	Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $75,000 – $90,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply:
11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

About Burlington Berries
Burlington Berries is a leading berry production company located in the fertile Northern Midlands of Tasmania. Known for delivering high-quality strawberries, raspberries, and blackberries to major national retailers, Burlington Berries combines innovative growing techniques with sustainable farming practices. Our operations combine leading horticultural practices with a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation, and excellence in every stage of berry production. Our team is passionate about excellence in horticulture and dedicated to producing premium fresh produce for Australian consumers.

Position Overview
The full-time Irrigationist Assitant supports the planning, maintenance, and execution of irrigation systems across Burlington Berries’ production areas. Working under the direction of the Irrigationist, this role is hands-on and operationally focused, ensuring that all irrigation tasks are carried out accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner. The role is ideal for someone looking to grow their technical skills in a fast-paced, high-yield berry farming environment.

Key Responsibilities/Tasks
Irrigation Support and Execution
•	Assist in daily irrigation operations including the setup, adjustment, and monitoring of drip lines, valves, and other water delivery infrastructure.
•	Execute irrigation schedules as directed, ensuring water application matches crop requirements across different berry varieties and stages of growth.
•	Observing the crop daily to ensure optimal fertigation programs

System Checks and Maintenance
•	Conduct routine inspections of irrigation systems to identify leaks, clogs, or wear-and-tear on components.
•	Support filter cleaning, emitter flushing, pressure checks, and other maintenance activities to ensure optimal system performance.

Data Logging and Communication
•	Record irrigation and fertigation activities as required, including volumes applied, timing, and any system faults.
•	Recording  water and fertiliser use and report on for each crop type
•	Communicate effectively with supervisors, agronomists, and other team members regarding field conditions, task completion, and issues requiring escalation.
•	Attending daily meetings to help align the irrigation/fertigation plans with the daily climatic changes and crop requirements

Infrastructure Installation and Upgrades
•	Assist with installation and modification of irrigation lines, control valves, filters, and pumps for new planting blocks or seasonal adjustments.
•	Work alongside contractors or in-house teams during major system upgrades or expansions.

Fertigation and Nutrient Delivery
•	Prepare and apply fertigation mixes under guidance, ensuring accurate dosing through injection systems.
•	Monitor fertigation equipment during runs and report any issues or anomalies promptly.

Key Skills and Attributes
•	Willingness to learn and apply technical irrigation and fertigation skills in a commercial horticulture setting.
•	Good attention to detail, especially when working with measurement, timing, and calibration tasks.
•	Reliability and a strong work ethic, including availability for early starts, weekends, and peak seasonal periods.
•	Ability to follow instructions, take initiative, and work safely in outdoor environments.
•	Interest in agriculture, irrigation, or horticulture as a career path.

Qualifications and Experience
•	A basic understanding of irrigation systems, pumps, and fertigation principles is an advantage.
•	Certificate II or III in Agriculture, Irrigation, or Horticulture and one year of work experience (at least 20+hrs per week), or have at least 2 years full time work experience in lieu of formal qualifications
•	Current driver’s licence required; machinery tickets (e.g., forklift, quad bike) are beneficial but not essential.

Salary
.       $72,000-$81,000 + Superannuation depending on experience

About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience to join our growing team and contribute to the development that empowers our organization to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Apply your expertise, technical acumen, and leadership skills to drive innovation and make a significant impact on our business growth.

Key Responsibilities Include:
Design and maintain Automation framework and scripts
Maintain and enhance test automation frameworks using programming languages (Java/Python/JavaScript).
Responsible for creation and implementation of test strategy, test plans, test data for testing.
Conducting and scheduling regression testing using CI/CD pipelines and documenting the results.
Reviewing requirements with Business Analysts and Technical leads
Involve with business and development teams to understand the requirements.
Review design documents for new features and participate in design reviews with the development team.
Involve in Client Engagements to understand the testing scope of the product and release
Preparing Test data by clearly analysing the requirements
Involve in Sprint Backlog refinements / grooming and planning sessions
Developing scenarios and executing automation scripts using automation framework
Implementing and maintaining regression test suite which saves the time for regression testing
Conducting demos to the stakeholders after completing the user stories
Preparation of Test Completion Report, Defect Analysis Report and share with stakeholders

Candidate Qualification:
5 years of experience in software testing as Automation and Functional tester.
Expertise in designing test scripts using Selenium Maven TestNG , Playwright, Cucumber and Rest Assured framework.
Experience in developing test plans, test cases, test data and test reports.
Experience in functional testing, User Acceptance Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, UI Automation Testing using Java-selenium and Web service Automation using Cucumber and TestNG framework
Extensive experience in SDLC and Agile Process
Designing test cases and test scenarios, conducted functional, ad-hoc and exploratory testing for the variety of applications with expanded test coverage
Experience in working with GitHub as source code management tools
Experience in Bug tracking Tools like JIRA
Effective time management skills – prioritization of tasks and own time by regular follow- up meetings
Ability to remain highly focused and self-motivated in a fast-paced, demand environment.
Critical thinking and analytical skills
Good communication and teamwork skills

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.
